name: Hjarni REST API
description: Hjarni is a Markdown knowledge base that AI assistants and people share; this API reads and writes the same notes, folders (called containers) and tags that its MCP server exposes. Requests go to https://hjarni.com/api/v1 with a bearer token in the Authorization header, send and receive JSON, and list endpoints page with `page` and `per_page` and report totals in the `X-Total-Count`, `X-Page` and `X-Per-Page` headers. Requests are limited to 100 a minute per account across all of its tokens, and going over answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
